name: Cube-Inward Representable Ample Classes Are Contained in Full Witness-Lattice Ample Classes
scope: Finite nonempty ample classes under the signed-coordinate and full ambient complement conventions; hierarchy parameters are held fixed.
statement: Every member of Cube-Inward Representable Ample Classes belongs to Full Witness-Lattice Ample Classes.
proof: For every actual cube, inward maps realize each native integer exchange-basis vector as a difference of two full ordinary witnesses; one reference witness supplies the degree direction.
